description: Set up the build environment and scaffold the ISOLATED experimental Android TV module `:mediaexperiment` with a distinct applicationId, then confirm a green baseline for BOTH the untouched existing :app module and the new empty module. This establishes isolation and the toolchain before any POC logic is written. The existing :app module and ALL its sources/manifest MUST remain byte-for-byte unchanged; the only shared edit allowed is adding the module to settings.gradle and creating a gitignored local.properties.
steps: Install the Android SDK (network is OPEN_INTERNET). Download https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip (the 'commandlinetools' artifact name has NO hyphen; hyphenated names 404), unzip so sdkmanager lands at /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager, run `yes | /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=/opt/android-sdk --licenses`, then install `platform-tools`, `platforms;android-35`, `build-tools;35.0.0`.

Create repo-root local.properties with a single line `sdk.dir=/opt/android-sdk`. First confirm .gitignore ignores local.properties (it should); if not, do NOT commit it. Never commit SDK paths into tracked files.

Verify the pinned Gradle: /opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/installs/gradle/8/bin/gradle --version should print Gradle 8.9. Use JAVA_HOME=/opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/installs/java/17.0.2 and ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk for all Gradle invocations.
Baseline the EXISTING app untouched: run `:app:assembleDebug` once and confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Do not edit any file under app/. This is the regression anchor.
Edit settings.gradle: add `include(":mediaexperiment")` after the existing `include(":app")`. Do not change rootProject.name or the repositories blocks.

Create mediaexperiment/build.gradle mirroring app/build.gradle's toolchain but WITHOUT any Cloud/LAN BuildConfig logic: plugins { id 'com.android.application' }; android { namespace 'com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc.mediaexperiment'; compileSdk 35; defaultConfig { applicationId 'com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc.mediaexperiment'; minSdk 26; targetSdk 35; versionCode 1; versionName '0.1.0-media-interlude-poc' }; compileOptions sourceCompatibility/targetCompatibility VERSION_17; testOptions { unitTests.returnDefaultValues = true } }; dependencies { testImplementation 'junit:junit:4.13.2'; testImplementation 'org.json:json:20240303' }. Keep release unsigned (no signingConfig) consistent with the repo convention.

Create a minimal mediaexperiment/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml with the application element, android:label from a strings.xml, Theme.Material.NoActionBar, uses-feature android.software.leanback required=true, uses-feature android.hardware.touchscreen required=false. Permissions and components are fleshed out in FEAT-003; for the baseline it can declare just the empty application plus a placeholder LEANBACK_LAUNCHER activity OR be completed in FEAT-003 — if left minimal, ensure assembleDebug still succeeds (a manifest with no launchable activity is acceptable for a compile baseline).

Create mediaexperiment/src/main/res/values/strings.xml with app_name = 'SceneVibe Media Interlude POC'. Add a distinct launcher/banner drawable or reuse a simple generated placeholder; if a TV banner is required by lint for leanback, provide a minimal mediaexperiment/src/main/res/drawable banner/icon so lint and manifest merger pass.

Confirm isolation at the gradle level: the new module has NO dependency on :app (no `implementation project(':app')`), no shared applicationId, no shared authority. Document in the module that it shares nothing.
Run `:mediaexperiment:assembleDebug` and confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL on the empty scaffold.

Commit on branch experiment/scenevibe-media-interlude-poc-001 with a conventional message (e.g. 'chore(poc): scaffold isolated mediaexperiment Android TV module'). Stage only settings.gradle and the new mediaexperiment/ files (plus the .agents task files). Do NOT stage local.properties or any build output. Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: Android SDK installed at /opt/android-sdk with platforms;android-35 and build-tools;35.0.0; repo-root local.properties points to it and is NOT tracked by git.
settings.gradle includes both :app and :mediaexperiment; no other change to settings.gradle.
No file under app/ is modified (git diff --stat shows app/ untouched).
`:mediaexperiment:assembleDebug` is BUILD SUCCESSFUL on the scaffold.
mediaexperiment applicationId is exactly com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc.mediaexperiment and the module has no project dependency on :app.
verification: Run `git diff --name-only c9b0efd4acfaaae9ed7da13dcec505b2f653c548 -- app/` and confirm it is EMPTY (no production file touched).
Run the pinned Gradle 8.9 with ANDROID_HOME/JAVA_HOME set: `:app:assembleDebug :mediaexperiment:assembleDebug` and confirm both report BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
Run `git ls-files local.properties` and confirm it returns nothing (local.properties untracked).
findings: Android SDK installed at /opt/android-sdk (platform-tools, platforms;android-35, build-tools;35.0.0) via commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip. local.properties created at repo root (sdk.dir=/opt/android-sdk) and confirmed untracked + gitignored. TOOLCHAIN DEVIATION: the briefing's pinned Gradle path /opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/installs/gradle/8/bin/gradle does NOT exist; the only mise gradle installed is 8.14.5 at /root/.local/share/mise/installs/gradle/8.14/gradle-8.14.5/bin/gradle (the mise 'gradle 8' alias also points to 8.14.5, not 8.9). No Gradle 8.9 binary is present anywhere. context.json explicitly states 8.14.5 'also works for assembling', so builds were run with 8.14.5 (emits harmless Gradle 9 deprecation warnings). Subsequent features must use this 8.14.5 path. Always invoke with JAVA_HOME=/opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/installs/java/17.0.2 ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk. settings.gradle: added include(":mediaexperiment") after include(":app"); no other change. New module scaffolded: mediaexperiment/build.gradle (mirrors app toolchain, NO Cloud/LAN buildConfig, NO :app dependency, applicationId com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc.mediaexperiment), minimal AndroidManifest.xml (leanback required + touchscreen not required + empty application, no launchable activity — deferred to FEAT-003), res/values/strings.xml (app_name='SceneVibe Media Interlude POC'), res/drawable/banner.xml (vector placeholder used as both icon and banner). VERIFIED: :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL (regression anchor), :mediaexperiment:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL, git diff --name-only c9b0efd4 -- app/ is EMPTY (app untouched), git ls-files local.properties empty. mediaexperiment/build is gitignored so no build output staged. testDebugUnitTest/lintDebug not run in this feature (no sources/tests yet); they are the gates for later features.
